title: 心理学概論Ａ
subtitle: Introduction to Psychology A
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1)	learn the whole picture of psychology.
(2)	learn in areas such as sensation, perception, memory, cognition, learning, and thinking.
(3)	learn about the history of psychology and research methods.
(4)	acquire the ability to apply psychology.
advice:
This class is subject to the credit system.

Students learn the big picture of psychology and understand the interrelationships of the psychology classes they will study in the future.
Psychology is a scientific study of "mind", a study that focuses on issues that are closely related to our daily lives, and students should understand the content of the classes in relation to the various phenomena experienced in everyday life, and encourage them to study while being aware that they will be used in everyday activities.

The progress and content of the classes will be adjusted according to the understanding of the content of the classes.

activityGoals.body: Ability to list some areas being studied in psychology.
Ability to explain basic keywords of psychology.
Ability to think of what you have learned in psychology classes in the context of everyday life.

              In this course, students will:
(1)	learn the whole picture of psychology.
(2)	learn in areas such as sensation, perception, memory, cognition, learning, and thinking.
(3)	learn about the history of psychology and research methods.
(4)	acquire the ability to apply psychology.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This class is subject to the credit system.

Students learn the big picture of psychology and understand the interrelationships of the psychology classes they will study in the future.
Psychology is a scientific study of "mind", a study that focuses on issues that are closely related to our daily lives, and students should understand the content of the classes in relation to the various phenomena experienced in everyday life, and encourage them to study while being aware that they will be used in everyday activities.

The progress and content of the classes will be adjusted according to the understanding of the content of the classes.
